text: In the bifurcated DAO of DAOs token design, non fungible reputation tokens give members voting rights while fungible reputation salary tokens let members earn a salary in proportion to their non fungible reputation holdings.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, A Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) of DAOs (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3799320
